decision: Add two append-only tables, certification_manual_discrepancies and certification_discrepancy_resolutions (one resolution per Discrepancy identity), plus a scope unique index on certification_step_versions for the correcting-record foreign key
why: A manual Discrepancy and a human resolution are records with actor, time and reason; an acceptance must survive rule-set changes, so it stores its compared values
result: Reviewed migration; unique indexes created before the composite foreign keys

decision: Compute rule Discrepancies on read and their history by replaying the pure check over every recorded Case revision; store nothing rule-made
why: PRD 9.1 and 18 let implementers choose; replay keeps open-since and corrected-by exact without touching every existing command

decision: The accepted application stays correctable with a reason until the Certification Decision
why: PRD 20.1 corrects the headcount after the duration and R01 compares the current application facts
evidence: certification.rest.test.ts application correction; certification-journey acceptance step
result: Accepted; replaces the Case PRD rule of no correction after the review

decision: The decision gate evaluates the check on the Case as the candidate decision would leave it, and the Certificate command refuses open critical or unaccepted error Discrepancies until #1294 moves the gate to the draft approval
why: PRD 9.1 and issue criterion 4; a decision dated before the dossier approval is R05
evidence: certification-consistency.rest.test.ts decision and Certificate gate test
